backend/main.mo: Defines core types and manages user profiles, tool listings, rentals, chats, and authorization with stateful ID generation and map storage.
feature_evidence.json: Structured feature evidence report listing feature IDs, related files, components, and test mappings for community map and globe functionality.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of many frontend files for reference in build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining light and dark theme CSS variables and global styling rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root container and script loading the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the TanStack Router routes and wraps the application in layout, theme provider, and toaster.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button component handling Internet Identity login/logout states and UI.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Wrapper component that restricts access to authenticated users and shows a sign‑in prompt if unauthenticated.
frontend/src/components/community/Commun: Renders a card containing a WebGL-based 3D globe with community member pins, handling WebGL support, loading states, and displaying selected member details.
frontend/src/components/community/GlobeM: Implements an interactive rotating 3D globe with pins for member locations using Three.js, including texture loading, camera setup, and pin interactions.
frontend/src/components/landing/Floating: Draws animated floating shapes on a canvas with parallax and motion effects, respecting reduced‑motion preferences and resizing behavior.
frontend/src/components/landing/Interact: Provides a wrapper that applies mouse‑based 3D tilt and lighting effects unless disabled or on touch/reduced‑motion devices.
frontend/src/components/landing/LandingI: A thin wrapper around an img tag that enforces alt text and provides responsive styling.
Displays a marketing section with a hero illustration, descriptive text, and stats for the landing page.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Renders the site footer with copyright text and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Displays the main site header with navigation, authentication controls, and a mobile menu using a sheet component.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the overall page structure with a header, footer, and main content area.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageHeade: Renders a reusable page header with title, optional subtitle, and optional action elements.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageShell: Wrapper component that renders children inside a padded container div.
frontend/src/components/listings/BrowseF: Filter bar UI for searching, sorting, and filtering tool listings by category, price range, availability, and keywords.
frontend/src/components/listings/CameraC: Camera capture UI that manages camera state, handles photo capture, errors, and returns a data URL to the parent.
frontend/src/components/listings/Listing: Grid display for tool listings showing photo, title, category, location, and availability with fallback rendering.
frontend/src/components/listings/OwnerAc: Owner-only dropdown with actions to edit a listing or toggle its availability.
frontend/src/components/listings/PhotoRe: Photo management field allowing adding URLs, capturing camera photos, previewing images, and removing them.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Active: Displays an active rental conversation header and embeds the messaging panel for the selected rental.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Scrollable list of rental conversations with tool info, participant name, and rental status, allowing selection.
frontend/src/components/navigation/AppNa: Wrapper around TanStack Router Link that applies active/inactive styling and forwards props.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: User avatar dropdown showing profile info and options to view profile or log out.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal prompting new users to complete profile details and submit them via a mutation.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalCh: Displays rental message history with auto-scroll and lets authenticated users send chat messages.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalRe: Form for requesting a rental by selecting valid start and end dates and submitting a rental request.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalSt: Renders conditional action buttons for owners or renters to update a rental’s status with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/states/EmptyStat: Generic empty-state card with icon, title, description, and optional action slot.
frontend/src/components/states/ErrorStat: Error display card with alert icon, message, and optional action element.
frontend/src/components/states/LoadingSt: Centered loading spinner component with optional message.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the current identity and invalidates queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication and loading/storing identities via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapTransform.ts: Implements advanced map zooming, panning, dragging, and pinch gestures with state tracking and clamped movement.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapZoom.ts: Provides simple zoom state management with wheel handling and zoom controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useParallaxMotion.ts: Tracks mouse and scroll movement to produce parallax offsets, respecting reduced‑motion preferences.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Returns whether the user has enabled reduced‑motion via a media query listener.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend actor queries and mutations with react‑query for user profiles, tools, search, and community map data.
frontend/src/hooks/useWebGLSupport.ts: Detects WebGL availability and reports support state, errors, and loading status.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, theme variables, dark mode values, utilities, and reduced‑motion overrides.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseListingsPage.ts: Page for browsing tool listings with filters, search, sorting, and a results grid.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityMapPage.tsx: Displays the community map, handles authentication, loads member profiles, and shows map and member directory with selection logic.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Renders the marketing landing page with hero section, calls to action, and navigation based on authentication.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailPage.tsx: Fetches and displays detailed tool listing info, availability, owner actions, and rental request form.
frontend/src/pages/ListingFormPage.tsx: Provides create/edit form for tool listings, managing form state, validation, and submission to backend.
frontend/src/pages/MessagingPage.tsx: Shows user rental-based conversations, with a list of threads and active chat panel, requiring authentication.
frontend/src/pages/MyRentalsPage.tsx: Lists the user's rental requests with status, tool links, and rental actions, loading data from backend.
frontend/src/pages/MyToolsPage.tsx: Shows the user's owned tool listings, pending and active rental requests, and provides actions to add new tools.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Loads and edits the current user's profile with fields like name, contact info, and address, supporting save and cancel actions.
frontend/src/pages/RentalDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a specific rental, including tool info, status, cost, and available owner/renter actions.
frontend/src/pages/RequestsPage.tsx: Lists incoming rental requests for the user's tools with status indicators and links to rental and listing details.
frontend/src/utils/fileToDataUrl.ts: Converts a File object into a base64 data URL using FileReader.
frontend/src/utils/geoProjection.ts: Provides coordinate validation and converts geographic coordinates to 2D screen positions using equirectangular projection.
frontend/src/utils/globeProjection.ts: Converts latitude and longitude to 3D sphere coordinates and includes validation and parsing helpers.
frontend/src/utils/rentals/rentalDateFor: Formats rental-related timestamps and calculates rental durations in days.
frontend/src/utils/rentals/rentalStatusP: Maps rental statuses to display labels and CSS color classes.
frontend/src/utils/timeOnApp.ts: Formats how long a user has been on the app and converts join timestamps to readable dates.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (query and hash), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them when needed.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration extending themes, colors, animations, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing requirements for replacing the community map with a 3D Google‑Earth‑like globe including pins and texture assets.
